items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I think Langworth or somebody -- all the shows.

ctx.x: I have them on what I guess is a bootleg album (inaudible) of the radio transcriptions presumably from the show you were talking about.

I'm pretty sure they were. Yeah, there were some made, because I ran into somebody down in Atlanta a couple of years ago, and he had the whole series that we had done on Little Blue Disc. -- I think Langworth or somebody -- all the shows.
Yeah, possibly. There's a large number of (inaudible).
